name: koloda-hearthstone-data
purpose: Shared server-side access to public Hearthstone card libraries and statistics for future site features.

authentication.method: none for verified public data endpoints
authentication.credentials: not collected or forwarded; GitHub login and premium/admin APIs excluded

retry.backoff: No immediate retries; later caller may retry after 30 seconds, honoring Retry-After up to 3600 seconds. 429 cooldown shared across resources.

idempotency: GET only; no provider mutations, automatic refresh commands or inbound callbacks

rate_limit.expected_limit: provider has not published a quota for these public endpoints
rate_limit.handling: 5 minute per-query fresh cache, at most 100 rows requested, one 5-second request per miss, shared 429 backoff

observability.correlation: path and observation time; no payloads, cookies, user identifiers or credentials

degradation: Return WP_Error on cold-cache failure. For transport/schema/429/5xx faults return last successful data for up to 24 hours with stale=true and an error code. Caller must display age or fallback. No HTTP calls at plugin load, editor save or page render unless explicitly invoked by a future feature.

disable_switch.owner: site operator; checked before cached data or HTTP

privacy: Only public game filters leave the WordPress server. No browser cookies, WordPress user data, posts, IP headers or credentials are forwarded. Cache expires within 24 hours and uses site-scoped WordPress transients.
rollback: Revert the integration commit through the staging/production pipeline; no content/schema migration or media changes. Disable switch is an immediate operator alternative.
